title: MACES — Banking Conversational AI
description: A multilingual conversational AI for banking client support, from model fine-tuning and RAG pipeline design to full Dockerized deployment on Azure via Terraform, with a CI/CD pipeline.

title: Face Detection + Age/Gender Recognition
description: A computer vision project detecting faces and predicting age/gender in real time.

title: my wordle
description: A cozy, pastel-pink take on Wordle — built with Expo. Guess the word (3 to 6 letters) in the same number of tries as its length, with a soft, minimal keyboard and board.

title: Maris
description: Maris is a fitness plan generator and tracker for mobile. It builds a personalised workout plan from a 5-step profile test, adjusting for age, availability, injuries, and health history. Users log workouts, macros, water, and sleep, and see streaks and monthly stats.
